description: A wide 16:9 pipeline diagram in two horizontal lanes. TOP lane, with the horizontal lane title 'Once, when the documents change' written above the lane at top left (exactly these words, nothing else): three boxes left to right connected by arrows: 'Documents (8 files)' then 'Chunk by section (one clause each)' then a box that splits into two stacked boxes 'Keyword index (BM25)' and 'Vector index (embeddings)'. BOTTOM lane, with the horizontal lane title 'Every time a question arrives' written above the lane at left (exactly these words, nothing else, no other lane title): boxes left to right connected by arrows: 'Question' then 'Search query' then two stacked boxes 'BM25 top 20' and 'Vector top 20' (each fed by a dotted arrow from the matching index above) then 'Fuse the two lists (RRF)' then 'Rerank (cross-encoder)' then 'Top 4 clauses' then 'Prompt' then 'Model' then 'Answer with citations' then 'Check citations'. The boxes 'Top 4 clauses' and 'Answer with citations' are sky blue; others white with grey outline. Labels as plain text, no brackets.
